payload.core_mechanism_summary: Greedy prefix construction: start with first[0], then add subsequent characters of first name as long as they are less than last[0]; then append last[0].
payload.rationale: The solution makes a greedy decision at each character: include if it makes the resulting login lexicographically smaller than stopping at that point. No sorting required, but the subtype greed_sorting_order is the closest match among candidates.
